How Angi works for pros

Angi matches homeowner requests to pros in the trade and area you choose, and charges per lead, with program fees depending on your plan. A request can go to several pros, so the homeowner may hear from more than one company. Angi also sells advertising placements on its own site. Read your agreement carefully for contract length and how lead credits work.

How Thumbtack works for pros

Thumbtack has no subscription. You pay when you contact a customer or when you're automatically matched to a request, whether or not they hire you. Customers usually hear from several pros, so the first good response tends to win. You can set a weekly budget to cap what you spend.

Which one is worth it? Measure cost per booked job

The price per lead is the wrong number to compare. What matters is what each booked job costs you. For each platform, take last month's total spend and divide it by the jobs you actually booked from it. Ask "how did you find us?" on every call so you know which jobs came from where.

Whichever one costs less per booked job is the one worth keeping. If both are high, that's your signal to build a source of calls you don't have to share. Our comparison page has a quick calculator.

How to get more out of either one

  • Answer within minutes. On both platforms, speed often decides who gets the job.
  • Narrow your job types and areas to the work you actually want.
  • Dispute invalid leads (wrong number, wrong service) promptly.
  • Move happy customers to Google reviews, which stay with you if you leave.

The alternative: calls only you get

Every lead these platforms sell started as a homeowner searching. Showing up in that search yourself means the call comes straight to you. That takes a complete Google Business Profile, steady reviews, and a page that names your services and towns.

Common questions

Thumbtack vs Angi: which one is worth it?: common questions

Is Thumbtack or Angi better for contractors?

It depends on your trade and area. The only reliable test is cost per booked job: divide last month's spend on each platform by the jobs you actually booked from it, and keep the one that costs less per job.

Does Thumbtack charge if the customer doesn't hire me?

Yes. Thumbtack charges when you contact a customer or are automatically matched, whether or not they hire you. A weekly budget caps how much you can spend.

Are Angi leads shared with other contractors?

Angi can send a homeowner's request to more than one pro, so you may be competing with other companies for the same job. Responding quickly improves your chances.

How do I get contractor leads without paying per lead?

Show up where homeowners search: a verified Google Business Profile, a steady flow of Google reviews, and a website that names your services and towns with tap-to-call and a quote form. Those calls come only to you.
